title: He likes ... But he doesn’t like ...
description: Practise expressing likes and dislikes, asking and answering questions, and recognizing ordinal dates and produce. 练习表达喜欢与不喜欢、提问和回答，并认识序数日期和各类农产品。
answer_note: Grammar answers are transcribed from the supplied grammar answer key, pages 467–468. Workbook A answers are transcribed from the supplied workbook key for Lesson 50; A1 is a printed worked example on the workbook page. Workbook B1–B2 are printed worked examples, and B3–B6 are transcribed from the workbook key. Textbook written-exercise answers are labelled suggested because no official key was supplied; written exercise B includes two printed worked examples. Grammar I.1 and II.1 are printed worked examples. No answer key was supplied for the listening questions; the ordinal picture cues are retained without inventing answers.

lesson.text:
Lesson 50. He likes ... But he doesn’t like ...
Listen and answer the questions. The page shows produce-stall pictures labelled with ordinal dates and item names. Read the dates and labels as printed:
13th — thirteenth; CHOICE TOMATOES.
14th — fourteenth; NEW POTATOES.
15th — fifteenth; FRESH CABBAGES.
16th — sixteenth; FRESH LETTUCES.
17th — seventeenth; GARDEN PEAS.
18th — eighteenth; GARDEN BEANS.
19th — nineteenth; RIPE BANANAS.
20th — twentieth; SWEET ORANGES.
21st — twenty-first; CHOICE APPLES.
22nd — twenty-second; CHOICE PEARS.
23rd — twenty-third; CHOICE GRAPES.
24th — twenty-fourth; CHOICE PEACHES.
lesson.translation:
第50课：他喜欢……但是他不喜欢……
听录音并回答问题。页面展示蔬果摊上的图片，标有序数日期和商品名称。

lesson.title: Written exercises A
lesson.instruction: Complete these sentences using am not, aren’t, isn’t, can’t, don’t or doesn’t.
lesson.translation: 完成以下句子，用 am not、aren’t、isn’t、can’t、don’t 或 doesn’t 填空。
lesson.context: Choose the negative form that completes each contrast sentence.

questions.answer: don’t.
doesn’t.

questions.prompt: He is eating some bread, but she ____.
questions.answer: isn’t.

questions.prompt: She can type very well, but he ____.
questions.answer: can’t.

questions.prompt: They are working hard, but we ____.
questions.answer: aren’t.

questions.prompt: He is reading a magazine, but I ____.
questions.answer: am not.

lesson.title: Written exercises B
lesson.instruction: Answer these questions using I, he or she.
lesson.translation: 模仿例句回答以下问题，选用 I、he 或 she。
lesson.context:
Printed examples:
Does Penny like tomatoes?
Yes, she does.
She likes tomatoes, but she doesn’t want any.

Do you like potatoes?
Yes, I do.
I like potatoes, but I don’t want any.

He likes cabbage, but he doesn’t want any.

He likes lettuce, but he doesn’t want any.

practice.title: A. Questions and answers
practice.instruction: Look at this. Now ask and answer questions like the examples.
practice.translation: 请看下表。模仿例句提问并回答。
practice.context:
Printed table:
Positive: He likes meat.
Negative: He does not like meat. or He doesn’t like meat.
Question: Does he like meat?
Short answers: Yes, he does. or No, he doesn’t.
Printed model: Does Tim like oranges? Yes, he does. He likes oranges, but he doesn’t like grapes.

questions.answer:
Does Tim like oranges?
Yes, he does. He likes oranges, but he doesn’t like grapes.

Does Penny like lamb?
Yes, she does. She likes lamb, but she doesn’t like steak.

Does Sam like peaches?
Yes, he does. He likes peaches, but he doesn’t like apples.

Do you like beef?
Yes, I do. I like beef, but I don’t like chicken.

Does Ann like garden peas?
Yes, she does. She likes garden peas, but she doesn’t like tomatoes.

Does Bob like meat?
Yes, he does. He likes meat, but he doesn’t like vegetables.

practice.title: B. The words too and either
practice.instruction: Agree with these. Use Yes, I do, too or No, I don’t, either. Choose Yes, I do, too or No, I don’t, either.
practice.translation: 对下面的句子表示赞同，选用 Yes, I do, too 或 No, I don’t, either。
practice.context:
Printed models:
Yes, I do, too. I like steak.
No, I don’t, either. I don’t like chicken.

questions.answer: Yes, I do, too. I like steak.
No, I don’t, either. I don’t like chicken.
Yes, I do, too. I like lamb.
No, I don’t, either. I don’t like garden beans.
No, I don’t, either. I don’t like pears.
Yes, I do, too. I like peaches.

grammar.title: I. Combine each pair of sentences according to the example
grammar.instruction: Combine each pair of sentences according to the example.
grammar.translation: 按照例句合并下列句子。
grammar.context: Use but to join the contrasting statements.

questions.prompt: John likes grapes. / He doesn’t like apples.
questions.answer: John likes grapes, but he doesn’t like apples.

grammar.title: II. Ask and answer questions using the cues
grammar.instruction: Ask and answer questions, using the cues given according to the example.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词提问并回答。
grammar.context: Follow the printed pattern: ask an or-question about preferences, then contrast the speaker’s preference with the other named person’s preference.

questions.answer:
Do you like pears or peaches?
I like pears, but my son doesn’t. He likes peaches.

Does he like jam or honey?
He likes jam, but his brother doesn’t. He likes honey.

Does she like grapes or bananas?
She likes grapes, but her husband doesn’t. He likes bananas.

Do you like tea or coffee?
I like tea, but Jane doesn’t. She likes coffee.

questions.prompt: your father / beans / peas / my mother
questions.answer:
Does your father like beans or peas?
He likes beans, but my mother doesn’t. She likes peas.

Do you like beef or lamb?
I like beef, but Helen doesn’t. She likes lamb.

questions.prompt: your brother / wine / whisky / his wife
questions.answer:
Does your brother like wine or whisky?
He likes wine, but his wife doesn’t. She likes whisky.

Does Sam like tomatoes or potatoes?
He likes tomatoes, but Tim doesn’t. He likes potatoes.
